text:
Type: chunky flatwoven area rug
Use: adding texture underfoot; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, minimalist
Materials: thick handwoven-look flat weave, coarse twisted yarns
Colors: dark grey, off-white, black, salt-and-pepper mix
Shape: rectangle with nubby wavy weave texture, plain edges, flat and sturdy, medium size, solid visual weight
Feel: cosy, natural, earthy, calm
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, wool and linen textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or rustic rooms

product.name: BASNS
product.description: The durable, soil-resistant wool surface makes this rug perfect in your living room or under your dining table.
